visual_encoding.position: two side-by-side dimensionless Cartesian coordinate panels
visual_encoding.shape: left original straight grid; right inversion of grid lines
visual_encoding.circle: fixed inversion sphere ||x||=r, not a viability threshold
visual_encoding.color: #87CEFA grid; #00BFFF inversion circle; axes use dark stroke
visual_encoding.motion: optional sinusoidal radius control, visual-time only
visual_encoding.point_marker: white-centered outlined circles mark user-selected input and mathematical image; not measured states
visual_encoding.inspection: pointwise image plus binary64 round-trip and radial-product residuals; GPU mapping separate

alt_text: Left: original Cartesian grid. Right: inverted grid with circular image curves and unchanged axes. The center is singular and masked in GPU rendering.
known_limitations: GPU precision and antialiasing depend on hardware and browser
a radius-0.13 render-only exclusion disk exceeds the mathematical singularity set
static reference is exact for r=1 while interactive radius may vary
no physical-domain interpretation or empirical validation
diagnostics are JavaScript binary64, not validated equivalence of GPU pixels to reference coordinates
point marker can leave the fixed plotting window at large image coordinates
